probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is __a surgical instrument for performing tissue ablation, resection, or biopsy__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the working channel to treat a brain disorder__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __such that the device creates a working channel of predetermined diameter__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __and maintaining radial expansion of the device during the medical procedure__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __after completion of the medical procedure and prior to closure of the cranial opening__.

7. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __by maintaining radial expansion pressure throughout the medical procedure__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is __a surgical instrument for performing tissue ablation, resection, or biopsy__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the working channel to treat a tissue disorder__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __and maintaining the device in position during the medical procedure__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __after completion of the medical procedure__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __during the medical procedure__.

13. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is __a surgical instrument for performing tissue ablation, resection, or biopsy__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the working channel to treat a tissue disorder__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __and maintaining the device in position during the medical procedure__.

17. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
